kind: ADDITIVE and IMMUTABLE. Corrects the rev3y objective WITHOUT mutating rev3y or any prior artifact

architect_decision.rev3y_window_mean_grid: REJECTED UNEXECUTED: the window-mean blend destroys 75% (beta 0.5), 93.75% (beta 0.75) and 100% (beta 1.0) of the intra-window slope and curvature energy, with a maximum label distortion of 0.09104 rad against a mean intra-window range of 0.06193 rad and a total negative excursion of 0.15516 rad
architect_decision.evidence: exact by algebra: inside a window the blend gives y_tilde - mean = (1-beta)*(y - mean), so amplitude and range scale by (1-beta) and slope/curvature energies by (1-beta)^2. Measured identically over all 7 windows and over the 6 stable-regime windows
architect_decision.consequence: no rev3y candidate is executed; rev3y remains immutable and unexecuted

objective.L_frozen_pointwise: EXACTLY the frozen two-role objective: r * mean_anchor(row MSE vs u_S0D) + 1 * mean_task(row MSE vs u_IK) + 1.0 * action-clip penalty + 1e-5 * July parametric anchor towards theta_S0D. The TASK LABELS ARE NOT MODIFIED IN ANY WAY: no blending, no weighting, no window mean
objective.q_pred_ankle: 0.7 * predicted ankle action, i.e. the production absolute decode of the ankle channel
objective.delta_rationale: delta = 0 is fixed. A positive margin was considered and rejected: at the window edges the IK target itself is only -0.003 to -0.013 rad, so any delta above about 0.005 would demand MORE than the target and reintroduce the label distortion this amendment exists to avoid
objective.one_sided: the hinge is EXACTLY ZERO wherever q_pred_ankle <= 0 and positive only where q_pred_ankle > 0. Unlike the rejected S1C-1 pointwise weight, it never deepens a command that already satisfies the sign
objective.contiguity_argument: on a window W that is contiguous by construction, 'every row of W has a negative command' is logically equivalent to 'the negative interval covering W is contiguous'. Per-row sign satisfaction therefore yields contiguity WITHOUT any coupling between rows
objective.applied_to: the TASK-role rows of the batch only. The anchor block carries identical inputs, so applying the hinge to both blocks would double its effective weight; this is fixed here, before execution

hinge_rows_frozen.definition: TRAIN rows whose decoded AB06 IK ankle target is negative, EXCLUDING the first negative window steps 6-14
hinge_rows_frozen.early_window_treatment: steps 6-14 REMAIN in the fit under the ordinary pointwise loss and under S0D preservation; only the hinge does not act on them
hinge_rows_frozen.early_window_rationale: S1C-2 established that this window is not observable from the 35D state (fold [1,100]: balanced accuracy 0.4725, positive recall 0.0000). Applying a sign hinge to rows the network cannot distinguish would push it to violate the sign elsewhere
hinge_rows_frozen.no_runtime_change: the exclusion is an OFFLINE row selection computed from the frozen IK target. No runtime clock is exposed, no input is added or altered, the clock columns stay hard-zeroed
hinge_rows_frozen.holdout_window: [267, 290], 24 rows, entirely inside the frozen holdout 201-300: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, it never enters the fit under any term
